title: ZeroDivisionError when num_slots=0
description:
File: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:310

slot_hash raises ZeroDivisionError if num_slots=0 is passed, since there is no validation before the modulo operation.

**Failure scenario:** slot_hash(eui64=b'\x00'*8, sfn=0, num_slots=0) raises ZeroDivisionError: integer modulo by zero

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
